title: Ranked Right, Sized Wrong: Ensemble Spread Fails Silently at Streamflow Extremes
abstract: arXiv:2610.20947v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning models, particularly Long Short-Term Memory networks, are increasingly used for operational streamflow forecasting, with ensemble spread providing a signal of predictive uncertainty. As climate change increases the frequency of hydroclimatic extremes, these models will increasingly operate under flow conditions that are rare in their historical records. We therefore evaluate whether ensemble spread remains informative under increasing flows, examining both its magnitude relative to error and its ability to rank errors. Prediction error is approximately $2\times$ the corrected spread at ordinary flows and up to $4\times$ at the highest flows, with the discrepancy increasing with flow (log-log slope $1.30$, 95% CI: $[1.20,1.41]$). Under-dispersion is strongest in observed extreme flows beyond the training record, reaching an $18\times$ discrepancy. This is pervasive and not explainable by conditional mean bias. Area Under t

translated_title: 排序正确，量级失准：集合离散度在径流极端事件中悄然失效
translated_abstract: 深度学习模型，尤其是长短期记忆网络，正越来越多地用于业务化径流预报，其集合离散度可提供预测不确定性的信号。随着气候变化导致水文气候极端事件频率增加，这些模型将越来越多地在历史记录中罕见的流量条件下运行。因此，我们评估了集合离散度在流量增大时是否仍具有信息量，从其相对于误差的量级以及对误差进行排序的能力两方面进行考察。结果显示：在平常流量下，预测误差约为校正后离散度的2倍，在最高流量下高达4倍，且该偏差随流量增大而加剧（对数-对数斜率1.30，95%置信区间：[1.20, 1.41]）。欠离散现象在超出训练记录的观测极端流量中最为严重，偏差可达18倍。这一现象普遍存在，且无法用条件均值偏差来解释。Area Under t（摘要原文在此处截断，后文缺失）
tldr: 研究发现深度学习径流预报模型的集合离散度虽能正确排序预测误差，但其量级随流量增大而系统性低估误差（平常流量下差2倍、极端流量下可达18倍），表明该不确定性信号在径流极端事件中会悄然失效。
en_tdlr: Ensemble spread in deep learning streamflow forecasts correctly ranks prediction errors but systematically underestimates their magnitude—a discrepancy that grows with flow (up to 18× beyond the training record)—silently failing as an uncertainty signal at streamflow extremes.
